kicker: LEDGER · Thursday 22 October · the street, the shop family's sample
title: Rita's front in the street
how: Shortfalls first. At night her window's light is far too strong for the goods: in the hook camera her glass burns white in three patches, and close up the whites burn and the red velvet stains the pale goods red (set aside after two tries; next, the strip lights under the shelves the cloud designed, at a measured strength), so no close night picture is shown. Close up her shiny goods show blocky marks from the cloud's low-quality texture files (set aside too). The front is clean, with no wear yet; the balls read matte, not gilt; PAWNBROKER under her name and the words on the glass do not read from the hook camera; the goods stand in tidy rows. The lamp columns: a shade darker as you asked, but the grime at the foot is faint and the rain staining read as grain after two tries, so they are not done.

The cloud's whole front for Rita's pawnbroker now stands in the street behind the street's own glass (the broken-window crime still works on it): the fascia with RITA'S, the three gilt balls on their bracket, the doors, the 3D display on velvet tiers and her room behind. The hook camera by day, the pavement by day, the front from across the road and the reverse view passed fresh reviewers. Taken today in the game at 2560 by 1440, shown at full size, with the street's people hidden (their clothes are a known open fault); the phone kiosk, the crates and the neighbours are the street as it was.
foot: Nothing bought or signed up for. Anything you do not pick carries onto the next page.
